notes.title: GAME STORY & POWER FIELDS
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hello Commanders! [/b]🦖[/h2]

[h3][b]We would like to share with you some part of the history that you can expect in Kaiju Commander[/b][/h3]

[h3][b]Who are we and why did we start checking the bottom of the ocean?[/b][/h3]

We are a corporation that has taken an interest in strange events in the Pacific Ocean.

Once upon a time, increased water currents, a red glow of light and huge shoals of fish appeared occasionally. Despite preliminary research, talks with seafarers and researchers of the ocean floor, we have not been able to get answers to our questions. While studying the records of anthropologists, we came across mentions of a forgotten civilization that may once have inhabited this part of the Pacific. However, we have not been able to discover why they disappeared.

Strange stories and legends about this place spurred the corporation to explore the seabed in search of resources and wealth. Thanks to them, we were to create new technologies that would make it possible to leave our competitors behind in the race for the title of the richest corporation. However, we did not expect what the exploration of the ocean floor would bring us.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41557031/1087d106ccaefd4960119b88db19faaa87a3e0b3.png[/img]

[h3][b]What did we find there?[/b][/h3]

After descending under the water and reaching the bottom of the ocean, we saw huge ocean trenches. However, this was not what made us dumbfounded. What we did not expect was a bright liquid that we could not classify as something researchers had already encountered.

The liquid turned out to be masses of pure energy in which a chemical reaction could occur. With its help, we were able to power powerful machines and devices. And WHAT no human has ever encountered before.

[h3][b]Why are we building a base under water?[/b][/h3]

Any attempts to bring this extraordinary liquid to the surface made it lose its color and properties. In contact with air, it turned into a hard lump, apparently resembling coal, but with a completely different chemical composition, not suitable for further use.

Scientists employed by our corporation decided that the raw material would be best tested in an underwater base built for this purpose. It was to be the first of numerous research complexes. The studies that have been carried out have shown that it was not the contact with air that caused the raw material to form a carbon-like lump. It was caused by the pressure change and the long period of staying out of salt water, which caused the breakdown of the intermolecular bonds of this raw material.

The corporation decided to keep the information about the conducted research for itself, and ordered the expansion of the underwater base. However, that's not all... A very small number of people also had access to the highest classified documents. The few scientists who were given a document to read would prefer never to do so, and what was written in it caused them panic and anxiety. The document described the project "[b]KAIJU[/b]".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41557031/fb7084cca1baaa344309f7526580e20399120f03.png[/img]

[h3][b]Power Fields[/b][/h3]

Scientists and engineers commissioned by the corporation created the project of "power fields". He is responsible for the extraction of the raw material. Due to the fact that the entire extraction process takes place under water, we can use all the power that this unusual deposit offers us.

The extraction of the raw material is not only used to increase the corporate capital - it is also necessary to supply the structures that make up the complex. Therefore, all buildings must be within it. Thanks to this, it is possible to carry out research and experiments, huge machines can be built thanks to this raw material... and most importantly, it is possible to continue the [b]KAIJU project[/b].

Over time, we want to expand the fields and find more uses for the power fields. This is just the beginning of the expansion and escalation of our corporation.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41557031/3e2641b9a4d57c7907f88d513c2df160d5cadbcd.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41557031/3b6f6a3ed5944134fe3df7208228a1dfee1be04e.png[/img]

notes.title: Underwater Base
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hello Commanders! [/b]🦖[/h2]

This time we would like to show you a little more about the underwater base that produces our Kaiju. It is the same base that you saw in the game trailer. The game will allow you to build several bases in various secret locations. Placing them in many points on the map will have an impact on the gameplay and a given region on the map. If our base is developed in a balanced way, we will be able to manage multiple underwater bases more effectively at the same time.

The most important points of our bases are the “power fields” which are crucial for the continued development of our underwater base. Our corporation, as the only one in the world, has mastered the unique technology of its extraction and use in the production of Kaiju, which is why it is extremely important that our monsters are bred among the power fields. More about "power fields" soon!

[previewyoutube=ObFPR7PGV2c;full][/previewyoutube]
